notes.title: minor patch 07.01
notes.notes:
-changed hold sprint key to toggle ( You no longer have to hold down the key to sprint )
-UI improvements
-minor bug fixes

notes.title: patch notes 19.12
notes.notes:
- performance improvements (also added key command "alt" + "8" (numpad) to kill all animals on map for better performance. The animal spawn procedure will start like a new game again)
- increased the stunning time of the animals from 10 minutes to 30 minutes
- Wildlife breeding system balanced
- Fixed a bug where furniture could not be placed on plank floors and ceilings
- added more usable weapons to hunting hut
- Names of collectibles are displayed in the HUD
- minor HUD improvements
- Foundations can now be placed under buildings to close holes and smooth them out (mainly aftermath buildings)
- Mine animations when starting/stopping production
- all fuel types can now be used in ovens
- prefecture collision bug fixed
- quarries now need fuel 
- Optimization of animal breeding
- some texture bugs fixed
- aftermath map bug fixed
- Furniture can now also be placed on the landscape
- minor bug fixes

notes.title: patch 29.11
notes.notes:
-added building plan "garden" ( over 150 new structures) for aftermath.
the building plan can be crafted at the research table. 
The decoration units which are needed for the plan can be crafted at the prefecture.

-minor bug fixes

notes.title: patch notes 23.11
notes.notes:
building foundations added ( aftermath)
crafting system balancing
Stairs added for both directions
Trees can now be planted freely on the map
Seeds for trees can be crafted in the Lumberyard
various biomes added to the Aftermath map ( The trees and logs will spawn once because of the change, even if you have previously removed them and/or built a city there. Sorry for the inconvenience.)
gpu usage optimized
minor bug fixes

notes.title: patch 18.11
notes.notes:
-Mines, traps and buildings now return full resources when destroyed (it is recommended that you have enough free slots in inventory)
-herbalists hut craftings balanced
-animals also harvest bug fixed
-option for automatic sorting of the inventory added
-windowed wall snap bug fixed
-Added option to adjust the brightness
-Improvements to the Russian translation (thanks to bigoshik)
-minor bug fixes

notes.title: patch 11.11
notes.notes:
- new buildings: hunting hut, well and fence gates
- Faster flying with Boost
- building collision bug fixed
- more XP for cutting down trees
- minor bug fixes

notes.title: patch notes 04.11
notes.notes:
-Fences can now be snapped into place
-Gold mine can now be purchased from the blueprint trader ( aftermath )
-minor bug fixes

notes.title: patch notes 31.10
notes.notes:
- issues with placing modular stone/clay wall structures fixed
- hitbox improvement
- trap in temple causing performance lags

notes.title: patch 27.10.24
notes.notes:
- The bug that the wolf does not receive damage has been fixed

- Breeding balancing for farm animals

ship parts have now numbers for construction order
